note:
ALA-LC Burmese Romanization Table, 2011 version, pp. 1-5; held source interscript-private-references/alalc/alalc-burmese.pdf. Extraction: the PDF text layer is real Burmese and Latin for the p1 consonant and vowel tables, the p2 medial table, the p3 finals/tone/punctuation rows, and the p4 numerals and abbreviation signs; replacement-character garbles affect the p2 medial-example stack, the p3 conjunct examples, and the p5 example lines - all resolved visually against rendered page crops (600 dpi). The eight p3 conjunct-modified cells are shape-font renderings with no text-layer reading; per the map description they are visual-only and are not encodable rows, so they are not enumerated. Print verification (codepoints plus crops): 34 consonant rows with the inherent a of Note 2, the dependent vowel rows with their variant forms (the dotted ု/ူ/ို cells are font variants of U+102F/U+1030, no separate codepoints), independent vowels, medials in the order y-or-r - v - h, finals (asat ʻ, anusvara ṃ), tone marks ʹ (U+02B9) and ʺ (U+02BA), punctuation, numerals, and the four abbreviation signs.
Correction table (text layer -> print): the p2 medial-example words (myha, krva, lvha, mrvhaṅʻʺ), the p3 conjunct examples (takkasuilʻ, tiracchānʻ, kambhā), and the p5 example lines carry replacement characters in the text layer and were transcribed from the rendered pages; the p1 tables extract clean (the အ row prints ʼa with U+2019 straight from the text layer); the tone marks print ʹ (U+02B9, dot below) and ʺ (U+02BA, visarga).
Findings (map-vs-source; transcribed rows EXCLUDED from the generated tests, never forced green; record for the maps-fix pipeline):
1. WRONG BASE CHARACTER (MAJOR): the map keys the whole jha family (93 rules) on DEVANAGARI झ U+091D instead of the Burmese letter ဈ U+1008 - bare ဈ and every ဈ-medial/vowel input passes through (1 row).
2. SIX CONSONANTS WITH NO RULES: ည (print ñña), ဋ (ṭa), ဌ (ṭha), ဍ (ḍa), ဎ (ḍha), and အ (print ʼa) have no map rules at all and pass through unchanged (6 rows).
3. ဲ ai: the printed vowel row has no map rules (1 row).
4. ေCါ ALT FORM MISSING: the printed oʻ alternative spelling ေCါ် (with ါ) is absent from the map while ေCာ် is present - asymmetric; both forms additionally fail via finding 6.
5. CONJUNCT VIRAMA OVER-APPLICATION: the map's C + U+1039 -> Cʻ rules fire on INTERNAL conjunct viramas - ကမ္ဘာ -> kamʻbhā (print kambhā), တက္ကသိုလ် -> takʻkasuilʻ (print takkasuilʻ), တိရစ္ဆာန် -> tiracʻchānʻ (print tiracchānʻ); the table's ʻ belongs to the asat ◌် (U+103A) / Note 2(b) case only (3 rows).
6. ေ-LEAD VOWEL COMBOS: runtime composes raw ေ + CV + raw ် (ေကာ -> ေkā; ေကာ် -> ေkā်) - a block-interaction defect class; it also blocks the printed o rows ေCာ/ေCါ/ေCာ်/ေCါ် and the example words koʻmītī and koʻpranʻʹ, and two p5 example lines (8 rows).
7. MEDIAL STACK r-v-h: the map encodes the y-v-h stack (ျွှ) but not the r-v-h stack (ြွှ absent for every consonant); the p2 fourth-order example မြွှင်း composes as mrvaှ plus a raw ှ (1 row).
8. CAPITALIZATION AND WORD DIVISION ARE CALLER-LEVEL: the table's Burmese-name examples print syllable capitals and word spaces (Moṅʻ Moṅʻ Cuiʺ Taṅʻʹ and two more names, plus the p5 line Duṭṭhagāmaṇi maṅʻʺ krīʺ vatthu); runtime composes lower-case unspaced (4 rows; the p5 lines additionally hit findings 2 and 6).
Bookkeeping: 93 rows transcribed; the rows array carries the 69 generated rows exactly (0 passing rows dropped as duplicates; 24 rows are the findings above, excluded from generation). The tone rows are instantiated on ကို because the map's hand tests already carry the print's own ပို့/ပိုး examples; regenerating via scripts/gen-row-tests.mjs from this artifact reproduces the embedded block byte-for-byte.
